fullDescription: Hardu Brutalist Tech Edition is a high-contrast, terminal-inspired design system. It blends raw brutalist aesthetics with technical minimalism, characterized by a monochrome black and white palette punctuated by neon green (#00FF00) accents. Suitable for software engineering agencies, cybersecurity firms, dev-tool startups, and technical portfolio sites, the style features a strict grid-based layout, heavy borders, and 'JetBrains Mono' typography for a command-line interface feel. Key elements include scroll-triggered scanlines, ASCII art components, and high-performance metrics indicators.
prompt:
## Resumo
A technical, brutalist web design system using a monochrome base with neon green accents, featuring heavy grid structures, terminal-inspired typography, and industrial micro-interactions.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system with the following specs: Colors: Background #000000, Text #FFFFFF, Accent #00FF00, Grid-lines #111111. Typography: Headings in 'Space Grotesk' (700+ weight, tracking -0.05em), Body and UI in 'JetBrains Mono' (400-700 weight). Borders: 1px solid #FFFFFF for containers, 2px solid #00FF00 for focus states. Elements: No gradients, no rounded corners (border-radius: 0). Background: 40px x 40px grid pattern using linear-gradients. Animations: 10s linear vertical scanline effect (white at 0.05 opacity); scroll reveals use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) with a 20px translateY offset. Hover states: background #FFFFFF and text #000000 inversion with a 6px hard shadow (no blur) using 'steps(2)' transition timing.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed top bar, height 80px, background #000000, border-bottom 1px solid #FFFFFF. Left: Logo in 'JetBrains Mono' with a green '>' prefix. Center: Navigation links labeled with numeric prefixes (e.g., 01_NAME) in monospace. Right: A 'btn-brutalist' with the text 'EXECUTE_REQUEST.EXE'.

### Hero Section
Min-height 100vh. Top-left: Pulsing status indicator '#00FF00 ● STATUS: ONLINE'. Main Heading: Text-size 9xl, line-height 0.85, using a mix of solid white and text-stroke (1.5px white) for 'HIGH-PERF' keywords. Subtext: Zinc-400 color, 2xl size. Right-side decoration: A terminal box showing ASCII art and fake system logs in size 10px monospace.

### Data Bar
Full-width section with border-y 1px solid #FFFFFF. 4-column grid. Each cell: p-8, border-right 1px white. Content: Monospace metric label (e.g., METRIC_A) followed by a 4xl bold value. On hover, the entire cell background flips to #00FF00 and text to #000000.

### Services Grid
Grid layout with 3 columns, border-t and border-l 1px solid #FFFFFF. Cards: p-12, border-r and border-b 1px solid #FFFFFF. Elements: Technical icon (Lucide style), uppercase heading, mono-spaced description. Bottom-left of card: small px-2 py-1 boxed text indicating 'PROTO' or 'STACK'.

### CTA Section
Full-bleed section with background #00FF00 and text #000000. Left: 8xl font-black heading 'UPGRADE YOUR PRESENCE.NOW'. Right: Large black button with white text 'INITIATE_CONTACT', size 2xl, font-black.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Brutalist Button — A high-impact, sharp-edged button with a hard shadow hover effect.
Padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; Background: #FFFFFF; Color: #000000; Font: 'JetBrains Mono' bold; Text-transform: uppercase; Transition: all 0.1s steps(2). Hover: Background #00FF00; Box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px 0px #FFFFFF; Transform: translate(-3px, -3px).

### Terminal Log Box — Technical decorative element mimicking a command-line interface.
Container: Border 1px solid #333333; Padding: 1rem; Background: transparent; Text: #666666; Font-size: 10px; Font-family: 'JetBrains Mono'; Content: Array of system logs ending with an ASCII logo constructed from underscores and pipes.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Use 0px border-radius everywhere. MUST: Use only monospace for interactive elements. MUST: Include the scanline overlay for atmospheric effect. DO NOT: Use box-shadows with blur; use only solid offsets. DO NOT: Use images unless they are wrapped in a technical [PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND] container with scanlines.

style.description: The style is 'Industrial Cyberpunk Minimalism'. It uses 'Space Grotesk' for bold, high-impact headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for all technical and interface text. The color scheme is strictly #000000, #FFFFFF, and #00FF00. Layouts are governed by a visible 40px grid and 1px-2px solid borders. Decorations are replaced by technical data, ASCII art, and status indicators. Animations use stepped timing functions and linear transitions to mimic legacy computer interfaces.
